down: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet, original fantasy human berserker matching supplied design references. Muscular HUMAN man wearing grey-brown wolf-head pelt hood (human face inside wolf mouth), long shaggy wolfskin cloak dark burgundy lining, bare tattooed muscular torso, black spiked shoulder armor, steel bracers, skull belt, brown leather trousers and boots. BOTH hands always carry three long STEEL claw blades. Not an animal werewolf. Pixel-art-like detailed painted RPG sprite. EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows, twelve separated full-body poses, equal cells, 1536x1024 landscape. Actual transparent alpha background, NO checkerboard, no lines, text, labels or ground. Each figure and ALL claw tips and effects wholly inside its cell with 12% margin. Same character scale. Row1 four distinct alternating leg walking frames. Row2 four attack phases: windup, extend claws, red claw slashing arc, recover. Row3 first two cells casting blue aura with both claw weapons visible, last two cells recoil hit and recovery. All twelve poses distinct. All twelve figures face FRONT toward viewer, slight three quarter acceptable. Keep both hands claws visible.
